summary: Iteration 5 tested ESC/POS thermal receipt printing feature (backend + frontend). Backend: 43/43 pytest tests pass (added 8 new tests: TestPrint x5 and TestPrinterSettings x3). GET /api/print/{sale_id} returns base64-encoded ESC/POS bytes containing 'Mandiri POS'/item name/'TOTAL'/GS V cut command (0x1D 0x56); 404 for unknown sale; 401 without auth. POST /api/print/{sale_id}/network with empty settings returns 400 with Indonesian 'IP printer belum diatur. Isi di Pengaturan.'; with unreachable IP 192.168.1.250:9100 returns 400 'Gagal terhubung ke printer 192.168.1.250:9100. ...' (real printer NA - expected). PUT /api/settings persists printer_ip and printer_port for admin; cashier PUT returns 403; GET returns defaults printer_ip='' printer_port=9100. Frontend (Playwright, admin login): Settings page renders settings-printer-ip-input (value '') and settings-printer-port-input (value 9100) plus save-settings-button. POS full flow: added product to cart -> checkout-button -> payment dialog -> Uang Pas -> Konfirmasi -> 'Transaksi Berhasil' dialog with print-menu-trigger (Cetak dropdown). Opening dropdown reveals all 3 items: print-browser, print-bluetooth, print-network. Clicking print-browser fires window.print() with no console error. Same PrintMenu confirmed present in History receipt detail dialog. No frontend console errors observed. Printer settings restored to defaults (printer_ip='', printer_port=9100) after tests.

issues: Store branding still says 'TEST Toko Kopi' with 'Jl. Testing No.1' and 'TEST footer' from a prior test iteration; store settings were not reset. Cosmetic only; admin can rename via Settings.

action_items: (Optional) Reset store_name/address/footer to production defaults - currently shows 'TEST Toko Kopi' from previous test artifacts.
(Optional) For network print endpoint, consider adding an explicit timeout note in the error message (current 8s is fine).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py build_receipt_bytes() correctly uses escpos.Dummy at 48-col width; includes header, items, subtotal, discount, redeem, TOTAL, payment, change, points, footer, and GS V cut. Exception on d.cut() falls back to feed - good defensive coding.
server.py _send_to_network_printer uses escpos.Network with 8s timeout and is invoked via asyncio.to_thread to avoid blocking the event loop - correct.
server.py network print returns HTTP 400 (not 500) on connection failure with Indonesian message - user-friendly and correct per spec.
server.py PrintNetworkInput allows request body override of ip/port (useful for admin ad-hoc testing) while falling back to settings - good.
PrintMenu.js properly disables trigger while busy and shows toast on success/error - good UX. Web Bluetooth service UUID 0x18f0 matches common ESC/POS BT printer profile.
Settings.js renders printer_ip and printer_port inputs with sensible defaults; wired to same PUT /api/settings endpoint - consistent.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_PrintProd products and small sales during pytest; all cleaned up after each test. One extra Air Mineral sale (Rp5.000, cash) created during POS Playwright flow. Printer settings restored to defaults (printer_ip='', printer_port=9100) after tests.
